title: Produce units: unit limits
description: The produce dialog shows, for each unit with a component limit, how many are on the board, how many are left in reinforcements and the limit. Staged builds count against what is left, the + stops at the limit with the reason, and a unit with nothing left (which the engine no longer offers) is listed with 'Limit reached: no <unit> left in reinforcements'. Numbers come from the engine's new display-only detail unit_limits; fixtures are synthetic mocked games in that shape (an engine test checks the shape). Before shots were taken on 80ce1bf1.

notes.title: What the engine enforces.
notes.text: supply.rs caps flagship 1, war sun 2, dreadnought 5, cruiser and destroyer 8, carrier and mech 4, PDS 6, space dock 3 per player by base type (faction and upgrade variants share the box); captured units and units on the Crimson hero card count as held. Fighters and infantry are uncapped on purpose. The production question drops an option when nothing is left and trims a batch to what the box holds. No rule was changed.

notes.title: Not modelled.
notes.text: No effect that changes a limit (Mahact or otherwise) exists in the engine, so none is shown.
